title: AxQM: A Textbook-Scale Benchmark for Formal Proof Synthesis in a Library of Finite-Dimensional Quantum Mechanics
abstract: arXiv:2609.05157v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Formalizing mathematics in a proof assistant, where a machine checks every definition, statement and proof, has set a new standard of rigor. Large language models are now capable of formalizing autonomously, even at the scale of whole textbooks. We bring this standard of rigor to physics, where theoretical arguments carry idealizations that are rarely stated fully, and any logical gaps could have a cascading effect on interdependent results. Recognizing the need to evaluate autoformalization systems for physics, we release AxQM, 1,019 kernel-checkable proof-synthesis tasks over 479 items drawn from the textbook Quantum Computation and Quantum Information by Nielsen and Chuang. The tasks are stated in a custom Lean library of finite-dimensional quantum mechanics. By task count, it is the largest proof-synthesis benchmark in physics by a factor of four. AxQM is derived from a near-complete formalization of the formal portions of the text

translated_title: AxQM：有限维量子力学库中形式化证明综合的教科书级基准
translated_abstract: 在证明助手中将数学形式化，即由机器检查每一个定义、命题和证明，已经确立了新的严格性标准。大型语言模型现在能够自主进行形式化，甚至可以达到整本教科书的规模。我们将这种严格性标准引入物理学领域——物理学中的理论论证包含理想化假设，这些假设很少被完整表述，任何逻辑漏洞都可能对相互依赖的结果产生连锁影响。鉴于评估物理学自动形式化系统的需求，我们发布了AxQM，这是一个包含1,019个可由内核验证的证明综合任务的基准，取材于Nielsen和Chuang所著教科书《量子计算与量子信息》中的479个条目。这些任务在一个定制的有限维量子力学Lean库中表述。按任务数量计算，它是物理学领域最大的证明综合基准，规模是现有基准的四倍。AxQM源自对该书形式化部分近乎完整的形式化。
tldr: 本文发布了AxQM基准，包含1,019个基于定制有限维量子力学Lean库的、可由内核验证的证明综合任务，取材于Nielsen和Chuang的《量子计算与量子信息》教科书，是物理学领域规模最大的证明综合基准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AxQM, a benchmark of 1,019 kernel-checkable proof-synthesis tasks stated in a custom Lean library of finite-dimensional quantum mechanics, drawn from Nielsen and Chuang's textbook, making it the largest physics proof-synthesis benchmark by a factor of four.
